patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I woke up gasping like I was drowning — I can't breathe lying down at all, I have to sit bolt upright. I'm coughing up frothy spit and my heart's pounding. Came on fast tonight.
clinical.presentationShort: 72yo M — acute severe dyspnea, orthopnea, frothy sputum, diffuse crackles, severe hypertension, hypoxic — flash pulmonary edema.
clinical.presentationLong: 72-year-old male with acute severe dyspnea, orthopnea, frothy sputum, diffuse crackles, severe hypertension, and hypoxia — flash (hypertensive) pulmonary edema.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → sit upright, high-flow O2/BiPAP, IV nitroglycerin, diuresis; rapid afterload reduction.
diagnosis.why: Sky-high BP + drowning in frothy fluid = flash pulmonary edema. Nitro + BiPAP fast; afterload reduction is the fix.
diagnosis.redFlag: Severe hypertension + hypoxia + frothy sputum + can't lie flat = flash pulmonary edema.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: bolt upright, gripping the chair, gasping
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 72-year-old man, sweaty and struggling, sitting bolt upright on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: bolt upright, gripping the chair arms, gasping for air. Expression: panicked and air-hungry. Clearly visible: a rigid upright posture, white-knuckle grip, and gasping effort. No text, no logos.
